verdict.rationale: Postman documents an official MCP server offering (postman-mcp-server) plus a Fabric Gateway quickstart for registering MCP servers and an MCP Generator to create servers from Postman API Network collections, showing agents can connect via a first-party MCP server. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that agent connections actually work end-to-end, and more detail on auth/scoping for agent access.
